title: Phone Backup Restore OTG Tools
summary: Securely backup photos, videos & files to USB OTG. Fast restore & data transfer.
description:
Never lose your important memories again! 🛡️

Phone Backup Restore OTG Tools is the ultimate solution for securing your digital life. Whether you need to free up space, switch to a new phone, or simply ensure your photos and documents are safe, our app makes data backup and recovery effortless.

With cutting-edge USB OTG (On-The-Go) support, you can now backup your data directly to a USB flash drive or restore files instantly without needing a PC. Fast, secure, and compatible with the latest Android versions!

🌟 Why Choose Phone Backup Restore OTG Tools?

📱 Complete Data Protection Don't risk losing your precious moments. Perform a secure backup of all your essential files. We support a wide range of formats including Photos, Videos, Audio, and Documents. Keep your data safe from accidental deletion or phone theft.

🚀 Powerful OTG USB Support Bypass internal storage limits! Connect any USB drive or OTG device to your phone and transfer files directly.

✔ Backup to USB: Move large video files and photo albums to external storage to save space.

✔ Restore from USB: Plug in your drive and restore your data to a new phone in seconds.

✔ Smart Detection: Automatically recognizes connected USB OTG devices for instant access.

📂 Advanced File Management & Transfer Take control of your storage with our intuitive File Manager.

➣ Batch Selection: Select multiple files or entire folders for backup with a single tap.

➣ System Picker Integration: Use the native system picker for easy navigation.

➣ Safe Delete: Clean up your storage confidently. Our "Safe Delete" feature asks for confirmation, preventing accidental data loss.

⚡ Fast & Reliable Restore Need your files back? Our Restore Data feature is lightning fast.

✔ Live Progress Tracking: Watch your restore progress in real-time.

✔ Selective Restore: Choose specific files or folders to restore—no need to wipe your current data.

✔ Cancel Anytime: Full control to pause or cancel operations if you change your mind.

🔒 Privacy & Security First We prioritize your privacy. Our app operates with transparency.

➣ Permission Management: We only request Manage External Storage permissions strictly needed to scan, backup, and restore your media and documents. Your data never leaves your device or connected USB without your consent
